lines.l: The stars above, they shine on me
And I can feel the light
It tells me it's gonna be alright
But I know that you'll never change
I know that you'll never change
The stars above, they bring me to you, the night is quiet, and I keep wishing I do, and I keep dreaming, I keep waiting,
The stars above, they bring me to you
And I know that you'll never change, baby
I know that you'll never change me
I know that you'll never change me
I know that you'll never change me
